answer: Treat the network like a walled garden where trust flows outward from a few audited seed agents, and each agent can pass on at most what it receives, capped at 5 units per epoch. A sybil farm of 10,000 fakes hidden behind a dune of shell accounts still touches honest agents through only a handful of edges, so the whole cluster shares maybe 20 units, about 0.002 each, too little to vote or earn. Like a drop of umber pigment in a bucket, its influence thins as it grows: each new clone just splits the same trickle. Caveat: seeds must stay honestly audited.
